purpose: Once-only post-selection robustness monitoring, never training/checkpoint/threshold selection or fresh quality credit
labels: New generic ASCII code literals; half confusable-rich; previous corpora/train/dev/fresh literals and tensor hashes excluded
transform: PIL affine BICUBIC horizontal shear on expanded white canvas, x'=x+tan(angle)*y+padX; complete original canvas support retained; whole resulting ink bbox+2 only. Includes resampling and is not a source-identical product path.
assessment: Compare active and frozen selected exact/CER/confidence/reject/padding; valid labels are retained because mild shear does not inherently make text unknowable. No automatic negative/reject requirement based on angle.
